## Description

Extracts the month of year (1-12) from a date, using the query time zone. Equivalent to `DATE_EXTRACT("month_of_year", date)`. The argument is a date or date_nanos value, not a unix-seconds long; convert seconds first (for example `TO_DATETIME(start * 1000)`). This extract is cyclic: `MONTH(ts) > 3` is not rewritten to a timestamp range.
